## What it is

The tower at 180°, the left side. Recessed 2. Four clips on the 965.2 mm tube, one quarter turn after the start tower.

## Design notes

- Print it on its side.
- The foot is the same 6.0 × 3.2 mm tab as the other towers. The 2 is recessed into the top face of the rib.
- The spoke is 4.29 mm along the tower, with a 2.15 mm 45° gusset each side at the rib. In print-up its top falls from 10 mm at the clip to 3.2 mm at the far face of the rib.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 1.0
```

## Don't

- Don't print it standing up.
- Don't swap it with number 1. The tab fits every slot. The clips would no longer be one helix.

## Changelog

- 2026-11-08: first 180° tower.
- 2026-11-08: notches and lug replaced by a recessed 2.
- 2026-11-08: spoke top slopes from the clip height down to the rib in the print-up direction.
- 2026-11-20: 26 mm pitch, 965.2 mm tube. Clip 10 mm, spoke 4.29 mm, gusset 2.15 mm.
